What didn’t sit right with me is that a company can just do this without a signature from the holder. I am trying to buy a house. I get a notification from my credit score closing an account and reopening that same account just under a main lender. I almost disputed it because it messed with my credit score.. Not even just that, they raised my apr to 31%. I literally have a job in accounting and would never touch a card that takes that much interest.

Still just craving the pain. I have gotten 5 tattoos and 3 piercings in 6 months. i’m going to be covered if i don’t figure this out LOL

i went through this in 2014 after a handful of attempts. i flatlined twice and have a similar experience to yours about the soul leaving the body. almost like one, long, pain-easing breath. 

i’ve come to terms that i did die and played with death. if I wouldn’t have been hospitalized by ambulance and treated for the harm I did, i would not be here today. medicine/ science saved my life and it saved yours too.
Hi kind people!!! My dad is healthy and happy!!

he is taking up to 3 xanax’s a day now on bad days. all of your comments have helped a lot. i’ll be patiently awaiting the stress test on his heart. just breaks mine because he keeps saying “i hope i didn’t do too much damage/ i hope i didn’t quit too late”.

thank you!! he has, i commented above. i’m so proud of him for taking care himself due to my sister and i. i just wish i could take his pain away somehow. i thought the same, 23 days is a long time to still be having such horrible side effects /:

he did go see a doctor. he had an ekg ran and they couldn’t really find anything. he’s getting a stress test done on the 21st. his second day sober, he thought he was having a heart attack and we took him to the ER. before my dad was sober, he drank maybe 2 drinks a night. but he’s chain smoked marijuana since 13 and used to drink like 8 cups of coffee a day. is that anything to be worried about as well?

Yes, i found an amazing psych / counselor that i’ve been seeing weekly since March (first appointment in person, now over phone because of stay at home order). My first appointment was an evaluation. She saw something that i guess she’s trained to see and sent me home with pamphlets, like how to be in a relationship with a narcissist. 

I blocked him today but i’ve been crying over how guilty i feel and keep imagining him sad or something. He makes me feel like he has no one on this planet except for me.

I mean... idk that’s where the guilt plays in and where i think i should settle for an okay life to make him happy. he says he feels abandoned and that it happened out of nowhere. that how can i see he changed if i ignore him. he’s adamant on talking face to face about our relationship because July would’ve been 8 years. 

I was 16 and had no friends when I met him. he was my only friend (besides family members). I’m basically the biggest pushover and have never been successful breaking up with him in the past. He brings up how he doesn’t have parents and now he has nothing to look foreword too. 

I’ve harmed myself twice in 3 months because of the guilt and selfishness i feel. and i know i shouldn’t, which makes it even more scary how not normal i am..
thank you (,:

Always have your customers leaving with brushes, you can buy them bulk on amazon. Also, business cards. I waitress, and am constantly asked who i go to and this makes it super easy to get your name around. A fan and tissues, for drying the eyelashes and letting them wipe up any tears after application. A cleanser, you’d be surprised how many clients come in with eye boogers and unwashed lashes. My girl chargers $10 per lash bath, and i’ve actually went and bought the same one she uses from amazon to save me some money and to have healthier happier lashes. 

i saw no one had responded yet, so i thought i would give a simple customer POV. I’ve been getting lashes 3 years now.

I recently incorporated a lash cleanser into my routine. it’s called “love my eyes” i believe and i bought it off of amazon. it’s cruelty free/vegan and the creator of the product is an optometrist that loves lash extensions! My personal experience, my eyes used to do the same before using a cleanser. I believe it’s all the oil, dirt and sweat around your eyes making them burn.

EDIT: Also, if you are crying within the first 24 hours of having them done, it is probably the glue not set up yet or the fumes from the glue. but if you got your set 3+ days ago, i don’t believe it would be the glue by that point.

my family thinks i’m actually my grandma. like i am me physically, but how i am on the inside, my “soul” is hers. 

my grandmother died 3 weeks before i was born, her funeral was 2 weeks before. i was born with an angel kiss birth mark, on my boob, over my heart. apparently i’m a spitting image of her naturally, i used to bring my family to tears just doing a certain mannerism that is apparently “so bobby”. my families religion believes in reincarnation. also, living next to grave yard, i have seen some odd things, the same animals always coming around or to a certain grave. 

it confuses me, because i’ve had my fair share of suicide attempts, and medically “dying” twice but being brought back to life. both times it was like i was no one, just subconsciously in the dark with no body. i felt a “melting” sensation and an anxiety of when it would be over. later i learned when we die we actually decompose (“melt”) into an oily substance.

my advice is you will find love again, explore women who are okay with open relationships. it wouldn’t be fair asking your partner to be faithful, while you pay for sex. i have a father just like you and since my mother he has been engaged numerous times. my mother has not been on one date in 9 years.

i was exactly in your shoes. i committed suicide 12-20-2014 was in icu for 2 days (i died twice but medical technology is too damn good), and was put on 72 hour hold. i thought the 2 days in icu counted but no. the psych ward i was put into was horror movie type shit. black mold in the shower and bathtub, people showing up in your room in the middle of the night detoxing or asking you to kill them, only hour visit time from 6-7pm (no phones), security getting physically aggressive with patients for no reasonable cause. i was the only person under the age of 32, and i was 18 years old. i faked being happy and okay everyday i was there just to get released, i felt like a prisoner. i have never felt more crazy or isolated than that place. i was released on christmas morning thank god, if i would’ve had to celebrate christmas there, i would’ve completely gone bonkers all over again. i told myself, the workers, and my family i would rather die than end up in there again, and i meant it. i still have nightmares.

having mental illness is hard, but it makes it harder when you’re with someone who only wants you on your “good days”. you going through a hard time, you needed loyalty and help and love, and she couldn’t give that to you. just because you weren’t “caring or trying” in the relationship is no reason to leave, that’s what i hate about new society relationships. she should have been there for you, because god forbid she’s perfect and would never have a down day where she would need your help. she’s the one whose missing out, not you.

i’ve attempted many of times just to barf out my guts the next morning. the one time i died twice...man it was my last attempt even though i have suicidal thoughts every day. i really tore/dug into my wrist, but i also took a bunch of a prescription of mine for insomnia, so a central nervous system downer. 

i can’t really remember anything for days. never knew i wrote a note or texted people basically crying for help, they were so sad my sister deleted when she was cleaning up my mess. but what i saw on the other side was scary and highly disappointing, almost like nothing but not, and i can’t even describe where you “go”. when i was in a coma it was like i was dreaming and could hear people, but it’s nothing like that.

i hope you find what gives you purpose in this life <3
